technique_name: Explain the difference between a penalty kick and a free kick in football/soccer
description: In football/soccer, a penalty kick is awarded when a player commits a foul inside the penalty area, while a free kick is awarded when a player commits a foul outside the penalty area. The penalty kick is taken from the penalty spot, a designated place 12 yards from the goal line, while a free kick can be taken from anywhere between the ball’s position at the time of the foul and the penalty area.
